description: This file defines the OrderService interface, which extends a generic entity service and declares methods for managing orders, calculating totals, generating invoices, and handling order status and download files within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Interface for order management operations including total calculations, invoice generation, order processing, and status updates.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a status history record to an order.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price for an order or shopping cart, with overloads for different parameter sets.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total price of a shopping cart, with overloads for different parameters.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF invoice for an order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists orders associated with a specific store, with an overload for criteria-based filtering.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order with customer info, cart items, summary, payment, and transaction details.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if an order has downloadable files.
